ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Stillsand
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
STILLSAND_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 — RimMandrake tier standalone build of the Extreme Desert biome (Phase A row 1 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md; parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1). A corrugated ochre plain under a star that has not moved since the world began: nothing here tracks the sun because the sun does not go anywhere; everything owns a shadow instead, or is buried, or is a giant carrying its own moving shade across a thousand kilometres of nothing.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it. `workerClass` is vanilla Core's own `RimWorld.BiomeWorker_ExtremeDesert`, reused unchanged — the donor twin never carried a third-party worker class, so no `RM_BiomeWorker_Stillsand` is owed.
⛔ Star Wars canon fauna and flora do NOT ship here — Q11a (owner ruling, 2026-09-22): a genuinely canon name is IP and must route through the Utinni campaign patch layer, never the franchise-free RimMandrake tier. 7 wildAnimals rows and 1 wildPlants row that carry genuine Star Wars canon names (kreetle, war wyrm, krayt dragon x2, granite slug, scurrier, gizka; bloddle) plus all 5 allowedPackAnimals rows ride src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Patches/WildAnimals_Stillsand.xml instead.
✅ STILLSAND_RULED_CONTENT_1 (2026-09-27 sitting, Q1 RATIFIED): this def now ALSO ships invented, franchise-free content directly — no longer empty. wildAnimals carries oommok (mirror giant), siidda (dust husk), a shade-mite commensal, drageye (ikee), vozzik, vekka, drazzik and aurrok (a grown spined-gow port); wildPlants carries the light-pipe nub and the ollim (+ its harvested wood, + a new biosilica harvest item). None of this is Star Wars IP.
⚠️ One row, JOE_Cephalope (qorrax), carries no RSW_/SW_/RUT_ prefix but is flagged in the item's own MEASURED STATE and routed to the Utinni patch file anyway: its ThingDef/ PawnKindDef live in src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Defs/Absorbed_Cephaloids/Absorbed_Cephaloids_Defs.xml (Utinni tier), so wiring it inline here would give a RimMandrake-tier mod an undeclared hard dependency on Utinni content. STILLSAND_RULED_CONTENT_1 explicitly deferred qorrax pending the owner's art-review sheet — left untouched here and in the Utinni patch.
Live proof (a scratch-world quicktest with all five expansions) is Desktop-only and OWED — see the item's own verify record.
✅ SANDBUSTER_CASTES_BUILD_1 (2026-09-27/28, dune_sea.md's ruled "Amendment — the sand busters"): ships the biome's one incident-spawned threat. RM_Ruukka (the giant eruptor) and RM_Oorrik (the grain swarm) are the two ruled castes; RM_SandBusterMound is vanilla Hive re-skinned (same thingClass, new comps/art); RM_SandBusterTunnel (thingClass RM_SandBusterTunnelSpawner, the one new C# class this build needed) replaces vanilla's TunnelHiveSpawner at the eruption point. RM_SandBusterEruption (IncidentDefs/RM_SandBusterEruption.xml) confines the whole mechanism to RM_Stillsand via its own allowedBiomes field — the planet-wide ban of vanilla's own Infestation is mandrake.rut.patches' Infestation_PlanetwideBan.xml, not this mod. Neither caste is wired into wildAnimals — both are purely incident-spawned, matching the biome's own event-driven/dormant design law. Art queued (infrastructure/artpipe/art_lists/ sandbuster_castes.csv), none rendered yet; every def ships with a placeholder texPath.
✅ DESERT_CAVERN_BEAST_EGGS_1: ships the deep desert's cave-beast (guzzka, RM_Guzzka) and its prize eggs (RM_GuzzkaEggFertilized/Unfertilized) — deep_desert.md §8's "huge shaggy thing deep in a cavern, with massive eggs a Jawa would cross a desert for" (flavor-only reference to a canon Star Wars creature; guzzka itself is an original, non-canon coinage, checker-passed and Wookieepedia 0-hit). Creature + egg only, scoped per the item's own re-file — NOT wired into wildAnimals and no cavern terrain ships here: caverns/permanently shaded canyons are not yet generated ground, so this def is defined and homeless on purpose, pending the still-unbuilt cavern-authoring item. The egg optionally carries Dubs Bad Hygiene's WaterExt (MayRequire-gated, per-list-item, mirrors FlowWorks' RM_ColoredWaterBottles.xml) alongside its own always-on narrative water-value stats, so it reads as water-wealth with or without that mod active.
